name: codexbar-usage
description: Codex / DeepSeek quota in the VS Code status bar, powered by the codexbar CLI of the machine the extension runs on (works over Remote-SSH).

codexbarUsage.executable.description: Path or name of the codexbar CLI. Resolved on the machine hosting the workspace (remote when using Remote-SSH).

codexbarUsage.extraPath.description: Extra PATH entries prepended when looking for codexbar (Homebrew dirs are not always on the extension host PATH).

codexbarUsage.showCodex.description: Show the Codex (OpenAI) weekly window in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: Show how much of the weekly window is left (default).
Show how much of the weekly window has been used.
codexbarUsage.codexMetric.description: Which figure the status bar shows for the Codex weekly window.

codexbarUsage.showDeepSeek.description: Show the DeepSeek balance in the status bar.

codexbarUsage.showResetCredits.description: Show the number of banked Codex reset credits in the status bar.

codexbarUsage.showCredits.description: Show remaining Codex credits in the status bar (hidden when zero).

codexbarUsage.warnThreshold.description: Weekly usage percentage at which the status bar turns into a warning colour.

codexbarUsage.errorThreshold.description: Weekly usage percentage at which the status bar turns into the error colour.

enumDescriptions: Match CodexBar's own behaviour: poll rarely when idle, faster as the weekly window fills up, and refresh when the window regains focus.
Never poll automatically; refresh only when clicked or by command.
codexbarUsage.refreshMode.description: How often the status bar refreshes. CodexBar itself uses an adaptive cadence, so 'adaptive' is the default.

codexbarUsage.refreshOnFocus.description: Refresh when the VS Code window regains focus (mimics CodexBar refreshing when its menu opens). Throttled to once a minute.
